name: zentra-store-production
description: ZENTRA STORE digital storefront with protected sessions, transaction-safe wallet and encrypted digital-delivery vault

scripts.check:catalog: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),c=require('./public/data/store-products.json'),i=require('./firestore.indexes.json');if(!Array.isArray(c.products)||!c.products.length||!Array.isArray(i.indexes))process.exit(1);const b=Array.isArray(c.badgeOptions)?c.badgeOptions:[];for(const f of ['key','label','icon']){const v=b.map(x=>String(x[f]||'').toLocaleUpperCase('tr-TR'));if(v.length!==new Set(v).size)process.exit(1)}const keys=new Set(b.map(x=>x.key));for(const x of c.products){if(!['android','ios'].includes(x.platform)||!keys.has(x.badgeKey)||!/^\/public\/assets\/products\/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/.test(x.image)||!fs.existsSync('.'+x.image))process.exit(1)}console.log('catalog products:',c.products.length,'badges:',b.length,'firestore indexes:',i.indexes.length)"
